description: Run StarXTerminator to separate stars from a view, replacing it in place with the starless result and producing a separate stars view. is_linear selects the unscreen mode: off for linear (pre-stretch) data, on for non-linear (stretched) data.

ml_version.description: Neural network model version (the process's ml_version parameter). Omitted, the process keeps its own setting.

overlap.description: Tile overlap (default 0.5). The former default 0.10 left a faint rectangular tile grid (cells of about 470 px) in linear starless images; 0.5 did not.

view_id.description: View ID to extract stars from (modified in place to become starless)

name: run_sxt
